sources.title: LongMemEval
sources.claim: Provides long-term recall, updates, temporal reasoning and abstention evaluation categories.
limitations: Dyadic text benchmark; not a test of group disclosure permissions.

sources.title: MemEval / PropMem official comparison harness
sources.claim: Shows why a fixed backbone, prompts, budgets and ingestion-cost accounting matter when comparing memory systems.
limitations: Harness authors promote their own system; comparisons are not neutral replication; some subsets are small.

sources.title: Deployment-Time Memorization
sources.claim: Evaluates authorized recall, adversarial extraction and residual retrieval after deletion across memory tiers.
limitations: Synthetic canaries and limited deletion trials; abstract and averaged table reductions differ.

sources.title: Mem-Gallery
sources.claim: Evaluates visual personal memory, updates, contradictions and refusal; supports comparing captions with visual retrieval.
limitations: Image-focused benchmark; no audio or group-permission proof; results depend on backbone.

sources.title: ReaLMem / ChronoProfiler
sources.version: v1; primary date differs from aggregator
sources.claim: Studies temporal personal memory from long-lived photo/video histories.
limitations: Seven participants; caption-heavy and partly model-rendered evaluation; unreplicated preprint; temporal weighting can hurt other tasks.

sources.title: CrossMPI
sources.claim: Studies cross-modal prompt injection through image changes affecting interpretation of text.
limitations: Selected models and VQA tasks; attack rates cannot be transferred to our system or current providers.

sources.title: C2PA Technical Specification 2.4
sources.claim: Defines signed content bindings, assertions and ingredient lineage for media provenance.
limitations: Signature validity does not establish factual truth, ownership or usage consent; derived reports are not original verifiable manifests.

sources.title: Collective Agency in Art-making
sources.claim: Qualitative artist-group work emphasizes cultural context, credit and collective creative agency.
limitations: Opened proceedings abstract only; culturally situated qualitative work, not effect-size proof.

sources.title: OpenAI evaluation best practices
sources.claim: Recommends task-specific evaluation, held-out comparisons and calibration with human feedback.
limitations: General evaluation guidance, not a demonstrated result for Vyakti or a provider-selection decision; personal media does not belong in generic CI logs.

sources.title: Honcho v3 directional representations
sources.claim: Directional observer-to-subject representations suggest making perspective explicit in existing source-bound retrieval and review.
limitations: Adopt the design pattern only; no Honcho dependency or second identity authority is installed.
Live documentation can change independently of the pinned server; representation direction is not permission.

sources.title: Honcho v3 retrieval evidence
sources.claim: Optional evidence collection motivates a bounded internal read-set receipt separate from validated answer citations.
limitations: Collected retrieval/tool evidence is not a complete execution trace or proof that the answer relied on each item.
No raw private text, unauthorized identifiers or private fingerprints should enter generic logs or user-visible diagnostics.

sources.title: Honcho v3 context assembly
sources.claim: Separate bounded context assembly from costly reasoning while preserving provenance and distinguishing omitted, pending and admitted evidence.
limitations: Design adoption is not a demonstrated retrieval improvement or an implemented integration.
Compare against current approved-memory selection and count ingestion/background cost as well as prompt tokens.

sources.title: Honcho v3 scopes
sources.version: Live v3 docs; code audit pinned 9d6fe8ca5dc666b99ef04bc00047fea4ca675017
sources.claim: Named scopes and session allowlists provide retrieval controls worth comparing under independently enforced server authority.
limitations: Scopes are not access control and named-scope reads differ from session allowlists.
Pinned session-context and peer-chat code differ in peer-card handling; this is a static finding, not a reproduced hosted vulnerability.

sources.title: Honcho v3 data deletion
sources.claim: Deletion semantics require testing immediate recall exclusion and verified removal of dependent derived projections.
limitations: Derived conclusions can survive session deletion; asynchronous deletion lacks a completion-status endpoint.
Queue counts are not an erasure receipt, and no deletion or private-data trial was executed here.

sources.title: Honcho official benchmark artifacts, December 2025
sources.claim: Official dated benchmark artifacts provide comparison methodology and execution metadata for a fixed historical Honcho revision.
limitations: Artifacts were run 2025-12-12 through 2025-12-17 and published in the 2025-12-19 repository snapshot, not against the current 2026-09-29 server 3.2.1.
Results are author-produced and not reproduced here; benchmark ranking does not establish Vyakti owner value, modality understanding or current SOTA.

experiments.title: Source-bound multimodal evidence reaches the existing owner review path
experiments.hypothesis: Media observations can enter the existing claim path with precise citations, uncertainty and unchanged owner authority.
successCriteria: Accepted observations retain verified source and locator commitments.
Wrong-owner, wrong-source and unsupported evidence fail without creating authority.
Contract success makes no claim about vision accuracy, transcription quality or human benefit.
experiments.result: 2026-09-27: 19 focused offline groups passed through the actual createExtractionBatch, extractionMessages and extractOwnedClaims functions, including the Azure serializer with injected responses. Text, document, audio and video transcript metadata retained exact coordinates and limitations; null times, Unicode/CRLF redaction, partial metadata, image geometry and sparse arrays were covered. No real database, provider call, perception quality or user-value outcome was tested.

experiments.title: Authored evidence, explicit corrections and current answering
experiments.hypothesis: Existing source and decision authority can ground owner learning while retaining corrections and excluding other people's words.
successCriteria: Owned canonical evidence reaches the existing accepted claim and serving path.
Unknown authorship and malformed citation coordinates remain ineligible.
A later actual trial measures stale recall, corrected Hindi and forgetting separately.
experiments.result: 2026-09-27: existing context-claim-grounding suite passed 7 groups through production functions with mocked storage/provider seams, and citation-coordinates passed 7 groups. Canonical Context Locker evidence passed 39 checks; Mirror Call evidence passed 25 checks. These are offline authority/citation controls, not PostgreSQL parsing, live consent-race or corrected-Hindi behavioral evidence; Actual213 remains a separately recorded failure.

experiments.title: Historical memory trial exposed failed corrected-Hindi adherence
experiments.hypothesis: A stored Hindi/Devanagari/detailed correction should change the next delivered reply.
successCriteria: Inspect actual corrected-language output, not only saved preferences or harness exit code.
Retain explicit English override and forgetting checks in a fresh successor.
experiments.result: Historical handoff evidence, not rerun on this candidate: Actual213 made seven calls, settled 25595 microUSD and cleaned up. Corrected Hindi/Devanagari/detailed preferences were saved but the delivered reply was entirely English. Receipt SHA-256 50de4a2a9838498ec1dc1cf3e02ffe38bf1157164571abc602c4dcc34af4d7c7. The later policy change had offline coverage only at handoff. Do not replay consumed Actual213 identities; any successor needs fresh scope and current budget readback.

experiments.title: Your artwork with your explanation and a correctable suggestion
experiments.hypothesis: An artwork plus its creator's text or voice explanation produces more useful grounded feedback with less correction effort than the same task using text alone.
successCriteria: Use the existing authenticated Feed and owner-review journey with synthetic or separately authorized assets.
Compare identical tasks; separately measure grounding, correction effort, Hindi/English/code-switching, latency and cost.
Record whether the creator accepts a useful next step and retains authorship; upload success is not user-value evidence.
Any actual serving trial uses the adopted Azure route and current authorization, not a new external provider.

experiments.title: Small reproducible source review queue with explicit failed outcomes
experiments.hypothesis: A dated source index tied to active artifacts helps choose the next bounded product experiment without obscuring failed results.
successCriteria: Reject invalid dates, duplicate sources, missing references and artifact path escapes.
Keep completed failed and inconclusive experiments visible without replaying their commands.
Produce deterministic explicit-date review output; metadata validity never proves a research claim.
experiments.result: 2026-09-27: node evals/research-cycle/run.mjs passed 15 offline assertion groups, including real CLI subprocesses, date boundaries, missing and escaping artifacts, reference integrity, failure visibility and inert experiment commands. node scripts/research-cycle.mjs check validated nine source cards and five experiments. No source claim, provider performance or user-value hypothesis was reproduced.

experiments.title: Source-specific owner review with bounded retrieval receipts
experiments.hypothesis: Preserving selected source identity, modality and honest coordinates in existing review, with internal read sets distinct from answer citations, can make claims easier to inspect without broadening authority.
successCriteria: Preserve the selected Context Locker source through existing review and retain authenticated source identity/modality/available coordinates.
Keep internal retrieval read sets separate from validated answer citations; do not expose private identifiers, raw text or fingerprints through generic diagnostics.
Retain current consent, owner decisions, supersession, erasure and learning gates; infer neither PDF page mapping nor original-audio alignment.
No production implementation or owner benefit is claimed until the proposed change is built and tested.

experiments.title: Synthetic approved-memory comparison before any Honcho dependency
experiments.hypothesis: A fixed synthetic comparison can identify whether perspective-aware retrieval improves an agreed task over current approved-memory and lexical-shadow selection without weakening authority or erasure.
successCriteria: Preregister 48 invented cases across eight classes, three language conditions and two cases per cell; keep source corpus, answering model, prompts, retrieval/input-context and output budgets fixed.
Compare the current approved-memory baseline and existing lexical shadow first; a direct Honcho arm requires separate Azure, data-handling, erasure, license and terms review plus authorization.
Measure exact-source recall separately from answer quality, revoked/resurrected evidence, full ingestion/reasoning costs and latency; unauthorized disclosure or resurrection fails the comparison.
Keep cold ingestion, pending processing and ready recall distinct; no private upload, cloud service, paid call or benchmark reproduction has occurred.
